title: 第6895章 奇观联动第6894章 万古杀墟困天阵
slug: 剑帝第6901章阴天子的悔意
lines: 推荐各位书友阅读：剑帝第6895章奇观联动（..la）看到这般场景，阴天子直接愣在了原地。
扭曲的脸上充满着不敢置信。
要知道类似这种混沌级别的宝物，都有自己的智慧，而且能够与自己的主人心意相通。
根本就不存在被偷走的情况。
未曾想到，如今这修罗冥王剑，竟然脱离了修罗鬼王的掌控。
事情似乎有些超出了祂的掌控。
对此，孙冰的脸上则浮现出淡淡的笑容：
“不过只是对付一具没有智慧的傀儡罢了，对朕而言易如反掌。”
言语间，他大手挥出，青萍剑立刻离开了他的手掌，朝着那修罗冥王剑飞去。
作为一柄从帝兵，不断蜕变，历经先天灵宝，先天至宝，一直到如今的宝物，它的潜力乃是无穷无尽的。
之前没有机会也就罢了，如今终于等到了机会。
这一刻，青萍剑隐藏已久的獠牙彻底显露。
只要能够将修罗冥王剑击败，并且将其吞噬，自身就能够蜕变。
所以它直接彰显了自身所有的威能。
饶是已经脱离了孙冰的掌心，可那凌厉的锋芒依旧让无数生灵为之侧目。
但修罗冥王剑同样也并非凡物。
其中本就蕴含着最为凌厉的杀意，又历经地府大道洗练。
所以还携带了死亡大道。
不过青萍剑作为孙冰的本命神剑，最大的底气就是蕴含孙冰所掌握的所有大道。
万千大道变化无穷。
正是如此，才敢对修罗冥王剑发起挑衅。
顷刻间，青萍剑迅速朝着远处飞去。
浩瀚的穹宇之中，只能看见两柄神兵在虚空之中交错。
碰撞的余波，波及了方圆无尽时空。
纵然天地之中蕴含着万千法则大道，可伴随着那锐利至极的剑锋划破，一切都彻底被斩断。
等闲生灵，别说阻止两柄剑的交锋了，连靠近的资格都没有。
因为其中的锋芒太过锐利，纪元之主在其中都会被轻易屠戮。
而且修罗冥王剑，本就蕴含着杀意和死亡大道，若陨落在此剑之下，连带着真灵都有可能消散。
所以地府的无数阴魂，都在竭尽全力的远离两柄神剑的战场。
看着穹宇之中互相纠缠的神兵，阴天子的瞳孔中闪过一抹狠辣。
对于祂而言，现在似乎乃是一个好机会。
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Sword Emperor Chapter 6895 Wonder Linkage (..la) Seeing such a scene, Yin Tianzi was stunned on the spot.
The twisted face was full of disbelief.
You must know that treasures of this level of chaos have their own wisdom and can communicate with their masters.
There was no such thing as being stolen.
Unexpectedly, the Shura Ghost King's sword was now out of the control of the Shura Ghost King.
Things seemed a little beyond His control.
In response, a faint smile appeared on Sun Bing's face:
"It's just a matter of dealing with a puppet without intelligence. It's easy for me."
As he spoke, he waved his big hand, and the Qingping Sword immediately left his hand and flew towards the Shura Pluto Sword.
As an imperial weapon, it has continuously transformed, gone through the innate spiritual treasure, the innate supreme treasure, and the current treasure. Its potential is endless.
It’s okay that I didn’t have the opportunity before, but now I finally have the opportunity.
At this moment, Qingping Sword's long-hidden fangs were completely revealed.
As long as you can defeat the Shura Pluto Sword and devour it, you can transform yourself.
So it directly demonstrates all its power.
Even though he had escaped from Sun Bing's palm, his sharp edge still made countless creatures look at him.
But the Shura Pluto Sword is also not an extraordinary object.
It already contains the most ferocious murderous intent, and it has been refined through the avenues of the underworld.
So I also carried Avenue of Death.
However, as Sun Bing's natal sword, Qingping Sword's greatest strength is that it contains all the avenues that Sun Bing has mastered.
Thousands of avenues are endlessly changing.
It is precisely because of this that he dares to challenge Shura Pluto Sword.
In an instant, Qingping Sword quickly flew towards the distance.
In the vast sky, only two divine weapons could be seen intertwined in the void.
The aftermath of the collision spread to the endless space and time in the surrounding area.
Even though there are thousands of laws and avenues in the world, everything was completely cut off when the extremely sharp sword edge cut through.
An idle creature, not to mention stopping the confrontation between the two swords, is not even qualified to get close.
Because the edge in it is too sharp, the Lord of the Era will be easily slaughtered in it.
Moreover, the Shura Pluto Sword contains murderous intent and the avenue of death. If one falls under this sword, the true spirit may dissipate as well.
Therefore, countless ghosts in the underworld are trying their best to stay away from the battlefield of the two divine swords.
Looking at the entangled divine soldiers in the sky, Yin Tianzi's pupils flashed with a hint of cruelty.
For Him, now seems to be a good opportunity.
